name: Radio
summary: Pick exactly one option from a small mutually-exclusive set, all shown at once.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-radio> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens, so both frameworks render byte-identical pixels. Radios sharing a `name` are mutually exclusive; selecting one clears its siblings and emits a composed `change`. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

whenToUse.when: exactly one from a small (2–5) mutually-exclusive set, all worth showing at once
one value from a known set of more than ~5 options — don't crowd the surface
one or more independent options that don't exclude each other

opinion.note: Pre-select a sensible default rather than leaving the group empty. Labels are sentence case and state the choice — 'Show results after each question', not 'Show Results'. Keep product nouns: Q&A, Word cloud. Reach for variant='button' when the options are short, mutually-exclusive views (Grid/List, Day/Week/Month) that read better as a segmented control. Reach for variant='card' when each option carries a title plus a line of explanation and the whole tile should be the click target (plan pickers, mode choosers).
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Radio component-set taxonomy: Radio-Group / Radio Group (dot radio + label, states rest·hover·checked·unchecked·disabled), Radio-Button-Group & Components/Radio-Button/Solid & Form-Item/Segmented-radio (the segmented connected-pill button variant), and Radio-Card (the whole bordered card is the selectable target — dot + title + optional description; selected = brand border + bg-accent fill), with size (default·small) and group direction (horizontal·vertical). Measured reference (radio|rest·hover·checked·disabled): 16px ring, rest border #D4D4D4, hover border purple-30, checked brand ring + brand dot, disabled #F1F1F1 fill / #EBEBEB border. Token layer: color-primary dot + button fill + card selected border (bg-accent fill), border-strong rest, border-hover hover, border-disabled + bg-container-disabled disabled, radius-default pills + cards, text-secondary card description. Motion bound to shared motion tokens on persistent nodes (dot scale, ring/button border-color, card border-color + background).
